questions.text:
Consider the following given grammar: 
 
S -> Aa
A -> BD
B -> b| ε
D -> d| ε
Let a, b, d and $ be indexed as follows:

Compute the FOLLOW set of the non-terminal B and write the index values for the symbols in the FOLLOW set in the descending order. (For example, if the FOLLOW set is {a, b, d, $}, then the answer should be 3210).
Answer:_____
questions.solution:
A [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] BD, so B is followed by D: FOLLOW(B) gets FIRST(D) [latex]-[/latex] {[latex]\epsilon[/latex]} = {d}.
D can be [latex]\epsilon[/latex], so FOLLOW(B) also gets FOLLOW(A) = {a} (from S [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] Aa).

FOLLOW(B) = {a, d}. Indices: a = 3, d = 1 [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] in descending order: 31.

Answer: 31

questions.text: Which one of the following kinds of derivation is used by LR parsers?
questions.solution:
An LR parser works bottom-up: it repeatedly reduces handles. The sequence of reductions is exactly a rightmost derivation traced in reverse.

Answer: Rightmost in reverse

questions.text:
A particular BNF definition for a "word is given by the following rules.
< word > :: =< letter > I < letter > < charpair > I < letter >< intpair >
< charpair > :: =< letter >< letter > I < charpair >< letter >< letter >
< intpair > :: = < integer >< integer > I < intpair >< integer >< integer >
< letter > :: = a I b I c I ......I Y I Z
< integer > :: = 0 I 1 I 2 I ......I 9
Which of the following lexical entries can be derived from < word >?
I. pick
II. picks
III. c44
questions.solution:
A word is one letter, optionally followed by an even number of letters or an even number of digits.
- pick: p + "ick" (3 letters, odd) False
- picks: p + "icks" (4 letters) True
- c44: c + "44" (2 digits) True

Answer: II and III only

questions.text: Which of the following comment about peep-hole optimization is true?
questions.solution:
Peephole optimization looks at a small window of consecutive instructions and is applied repeatedly, since one improvement can enable another.

Answer: It is applied to small part of the code and applied repeatedly

It is applied in symbol table to optimize the memory requirements.

questions.solution:
A DU-chain links a definition of a variable to all the uses it reaches. It is computed by static data-flow analysis and is used by optimizations such as constant propagation and common sub-expression elimination.

Answer: All of the above
